What I offer

A different theme each time.

Every offering is the same instruments held differently. Each session is quoted individually, and travel to your home, office or venue is included.

60 minutes

Group Sound Baths

For friends, studios, community spaces and celebrations. Roughly an hour of continuous sound, then silence, then tea if the venue allows it.

60 minutes · one person

1:1 Sound Healing Sessions

Tibetan singing bowl sessions tailored to you, in person or at your space. A short conversation first, then sound played close — bowls played near the body, voice used sparingly. Suited to people who find group rooms distracting.

45–90 minutes · up to 20 people

Corporate Wellness Sessions

Sound healing brought into offsites, wellness weeks and team days. A brief framing of what sound is and isn't, the session itself, and space for questions afterwards.

By arrangement

Ceremony & private events

Weddings, namings, memorials, milestone birthdays, retreat closings. Sound written around the shape of your day, agreed with you beforehand rather than improvised at you.
